answer_1.quote: VLMs generate admissible procedural plan composed by actions and objects... The goal is to place one of each item inside one of the baskets... VLMs generate admissible procedural plans without natural language using the planning steps described with action(object).
answer_1.outputs: action sequences (e.g., walk_to(table), grab(cookie), place_inside(basket_1, cookie))

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics over VLM generated procedural plan P* and gold plan P have two types: human evaluation and automatic evaluation. ... automatic evaluation is conducted based on the Ngram based metric: longest common subsequence (LCS), and BLEURT-based accuracy score.

answer_4.quote: We ask human annotators to annotate the correctness and commonsense satisfaction of P*. Correctness is 1 if the entire plan can achieve the final activity goal... Commonsense satisfaction is 1 if every procedural step is commonsense plausible.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate each generated plan on two criteria: whether the plan achieves the goal (correctness) and whether each step is commonsense plausible (commonsense satisfaction).
